summary: Fulton Financial Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $300 million underwritten public offering of 5.950% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036, under an existing S-3ASR shelf registration. The proceeds will repay $195 million of outstanding 3.250% subordinated notes due 2030 and for general corporate purposes. The offering was conducted via underwriting agreement with Piper Sandler and J.P. Morgan. The notes are subordinated, unsecured, and structurally subordinated to subsidiary obligations. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation event.
